messages:
aj: Heads up — bakery publish job bumped into Docker Hub rate limits and then we discovered multiple image tags were being retagged instead of promoted by digest, causing GitOps to flip deployments repeatedly.

maria: ugh. is this the job that runs on the gpu-builder workers? those have been noisy.

aj: yes — gpu-builder pool is used for a couple infra-tool images (tests compile with CUDA toolchain). When jobs retry we saturate the pool and sched latency spikes.

ryan: can you paste the failing log?

ci-bot: build-1876543209: publishing infra/bakery:latest -> rate limit 429 from registry.redwood.ai

aj: snippet: ```
ERROR: received 429 Too Many Requests from registry.redwood.ai while pushing manifest for infra/bakery:latest
Retrying (1/5)
```

sam: A couple quick notes: (1) we should stop using mutable tags as the deploy trigger, (2) implement digest promotion in a single step so GitOps only sees manifest digest changes, not transient retags.

maria: +1. Also: pin SBOM artifacts to the digest and attach SBOM metadata to the manifest annotations. That way the deploy pipeline can verify provenance without being sensitive to tag churn.

ryan: For immediate relief we can throttle parallel pushes from the bakery CI (limit concurrency to 3), and add exponential backoff with jitter on registry errors. That'll reduce 429s and free gpu-builder slots faster.

aj: Agreed. I can add concurrency limiter in the GitLab job: ```parallel: 3``` and `DOCKER_PUSH_RETRIES=8` with backoff.

sam: Long term plan: switch to content-addressable tagging + promotion job. Flow: build -> push by digest -> create lightweight promotion manifest where we copy digest to a stable release tag using registry API (no rebuild). Then run cosign signing + attach SBOM as an OCI artifact.

maria: Example registry promotion call (pseudo): ```
curl -X PUT https://registry.redwood.ai/v2/infra/bakery/manifests/release-2026-03-18 \
  -H "Content-Type: application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json" \
  --data-binary @manifest-by-digest.json
```
That avoids a second full push.

ryan: And then GitOps should only watch the imageDigest field in values.yaml / HelmRelease. If digest change -> rollout, otherwise ignore tag-only updates.

aj: Right now our Helm values use `image.tag: latest`. We need to move to `image.digest: sha256:...` in CI output. Also update bake pipeline to emit `image.digest` into the ArgoCD declarative-image-updater or Helm chart generator.

maria: We also need SBOM pinning rule in the manifest: add annotation `io.redwood.sbom.digest` with the sbom sha so the console and audits can always find the exact SBOM for a deployed digest.

sam: For signing, add cosign verify step in the deploy gate: `cosign verify --key ksm://projects/redwood/keys/cosign infra/bakery@sha256:...` and fail if not present.

aj: Quick question: do we want to run SBOM generation on GPU builders? It's heavier and contributes to GPU contention. Could generate SBOMs on aux CPU-only runners after pushing the digest.

ryan: yes move SBOM and signing off the GPU workers. Keep the GPU pool for the CUDA compile step only. Then a follow-up job on cpu-builders does `syft` -> produces sbom.json -> attach via registry OR store in provenance bucket and write pointer annotation.

maria: CI snippet idea: ```
- build (gpu-builder) -> push by digest -> upload manifest.json to artifact store
- promote (cpu-builder) -> attach SBOM & sign -> update image digest in gitops repo
```

aj: We should also add a small backpressure controller for bakery: a centralized leaky-bucket limit that both CI and manual pushes check. Could be a small service or a redis token bucket.

sam: Another ops item: update Terraform-managed registry quotas so non-prod teams don't exhaust our shared registry plan. Add per-team rate caps and alerting on 80% of quota.

ryan: I'll open a quick PR to: reduce parallel pushes, move SBOM/signing off gpu builders, and add digest promotion step. Can someone own the Terraform quota change?

maria: I can take the Terraform change. I'll also add an alert in pager duty if registry 429s spike >5% in 10m.

aj: thanks. Action items: (1) ryan PR for CI changes, (2) maria PR for registry quota & alerting, (3) sam to prototype token-bucket limiter, (4) update GitOps to consume image.digest not tag.

srebot: Incident created: #INC-2026-04 - bakery publish rate-limit + builder saturation. Linked runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/registry-rate-limits

aj: I'll follow up after ryan's PR lands and run a smoke deploy. :thumbsup:

sam: FYI, small UX callout — console should display both tag and digest and link to the SBOM and cosign verification. Makes audits easier.

ryan: noted. I'll include digest emission in the CI job artifact so console can scrape it.

maria: Thanks everyone — saving the GPU pool for real work again :)

aj: closing the thread once PRs are merged.
